title: Find your wedding style
intro: Sixteen quick picture questions, one color step, and a few optional planning details. About four minutes.
flow: planning details (optional, skippable): occasion, guest_count, budget_band, season, region, setting, priority, kids

color_step.text: Tap the color palettes you love. Pick up to 3.
color_step.grid_order: shuffled once per session (seeded) so no style is always first; show name + 5 swatches; swatch tooltip shows color name and hex
color_step.scoring: Each picked palette adds weight_per_pick points to its style_id.

filter.rule: elopement: no hard filter; sort small venues first and set guest_count to under_20 if not answered. wedding: no filter.

planning_details.text: How many guests are you dreaming of?

filter.rule: keep venue if capacity_reception >= option.max (or >= option.min when max is null), or capacity_reception is 'not published' (kept, flagged 'capacity not published').

label_for_summary.under_20: just a few of your closest people

planning_details.text: Where does your budget feel comfortable?

filter.mode: soft (pre-selects the budget chip; user can clear)
filter.rule: budget_tier_index points into the venues.json budget_tier enum in its listed order (lowest, middle, highest). Keep venues whose tier index <= chosen index, plus tier 'unknown' (shown with 'price on request'). not_sure = no filter.
filter.copy_rule: Customer copy shows the band labels above; tier labels on venue cards come from venues.json.

filter.mode: soft (pre-selects season chip; user can clear)
filter.rule: case-insensitive: keep venue if best_season text contains the season word, or 'year-round'/'any'/'all year', or venue setting is indoor/both (weather-proof). Months map to seasons: Mar-May spring, Jun-Aug summer, Sep-Nov fall, Dec-Feb winter. flexible = no filter.

planning_details.text: Where in the world? Pick any that appeal.

filter.rule: keep venue if venue.region is in the chosen region_values; 'anywhere' or no answer = no filter.
keep venue if venue.setting is in option.keep.

extra_optional.text: If you could only splurge on ONE thing...
extra_optional.use: Budget split boost (styles.json budget_priority_boost). Not scored.
Personalizes result copy only (e.g., 'kid-friendly lawn games'). Not scored, not a filter.

scoring.method: Start every style at 0. For each answered style question add the chosen option's weights. For each picked palette add 2 to that palette's style. Planning details never change style scores.
scoring.skipped_questions: Allowed; a skipped question adds nothing.
scoring.rank: Sort styles by total, high to low.
scoring.match_percent: Top 3 normalized to 100: pct_i = 100 * score_i / (score_1 + score_2 + score_3), rounded with largest-remainder so the three add to exactly 100. If all three are 0, show the result as not enough answers.
tie_break: 2. More questions where the style scored at least 1 point (breadth).
3. Higher points from the two anchor questions (ceremony_place + vibe).
4. More palette picks for that style.
5. Earlier position in styles.json styles list.
scoring.displayed_equals_computed: The results page shows exactly the top 3 of this ranking, in this order.
scoring.chosen_palette: Show the couple's first picked palette that belongs to the #1 style; else their first pick; else the #1 style's primary palette. The #2 style's primary palette is offered as an alternate color story.

summary_templates.primary: {couple}, your style is {style1} ({pct1}%) with touches of {style2} ({pct2}%) and {style3} ({pct3}%). Signature moment: {signature_moment}
summary_templates.one_liner: A {season_label} {setting_label} {occasion_label} for {guest_label}: {style1} soul, {style2} heart, and a {food_label} everyone will talk about.
summary_templates.cleanup: Collapse double spaces left by omitted words.

results.next_steps: Show matched venues: apply planning filters, then sort by venue_rubric score (which includes style match).

venue_rubric.origin: partner 100-point venue rubric, ported with automatic formulas
venue_rubric.how_scored: Each criterion is AUTO (computed from venues.json fields + couple answers), SEMI (auto default, planner can override) or MANUAL (planner rates). A criterion with no couple input (question skipped) or an unrated MANUAL criterion is left out, and the score is rescaled: score = round(100 * earned / available). The card shows which criteria were used.

criteria.compute: Tier index of venue vs couple band index. When the price covers the whole event (full package or per-person dinner): venue <= band -> 14; one above -> 5; two above -> 0. When the price is a starting venue fee only (rental, site fee, ceremony fee), the tier says little about the wedding total, so it is labelled 'starting fee only' and capped: venue <= band -> 9; one above -> 3; two above -> 0. Venue tier 'unknown' (price on request) -> 7. Skipped/not_sure -> excluded.
capacity >= band max (or min when open-ended) -> 10; capacity >= band min -> 7; below band min -> 0; 'not published' -> 5. Elopement with no guest answer uses under_20.

If style_tags contains your #1 style -> 30; else #2 -> 22; else #3 -> 15; else if venue type is in the #1 style's venue_type_affinity -> 8; else 0. Style is the largest single part. Ranking rule: venues tagged with one of your top 3 styles always rank above venues that only fit by venue type, and those rank above venues with no style match; the score orders venues inside each group.

best_season names the couple's season (or year-round) -> 8; text is 'region typical: ...' and includes it -> 6; not matched but setting indoor/both -> 5; outdoor-only and not matched -> 2; best_season 'not published' -> 4. Flexible/skipped -> excluded.
outside allowed -> 6; in-house optional -> 5; in-house required -> 3; not published -> 3.
on-site lodging yes -> 4, unknown -> 2, no -> 0; plus 2 if a nearest airport is published.
setting 'both' -> 8; pros mention ceremony and reception on site -> 8; otherwise 4. Planner may override.
Planner rates 0-8 after viewing gallery. Excluded until rated.
setting both -> 5; indoor -> 5; outdoor -> 1 (raise to 3 if pros/cons name a tent or indoor backup).
Planner rates 0-5 for known vendor relationships. Excluded until rated.

venue_rubric.weights_version: v6.2 (2026-10-10): style-first. style 20->30, budget 16->14 (venue-fee-only prices capped at 9), capacity 12->10, season 10->8, catering 8->6, lodging+airport 8->6; one site 8, rain plan 5, wow 8 and planner network 5 unchanged; total still 100
